anne-devex: FWIW sampleapp onboarding: logs drop req_id on retries. Minimal repro in sandbox.
anne-devex: snippet:
```
ERROR fetch failed attempt=1
INFO fetch retry attempt=2
```
sam-telemetry: which SDK/version?
anne-devex: node 0.9.2, autoinit.
kai-eng: sounds like logger hook runs before OTEL context attach. Retry middleware creates new async boundary.
sam-telemetry: short-term: add fallback to read traceparent header in logger. Long-term: change Node autoinit order and add sampleapp doc note to call `await telemetry.bootstrap()` early.
anne-devex: opening PR for doc + small guard. infra-bot: @anne-devex created INFRA-1256.
